name: Streaker Roulette
hook: Stack chips fast before casino security throws you a bath towel
tagline: You sit unclothed at high roller tables stacking stacks of chips while bouncers whisper furiously into earpieces. Cash out to slip into a VIP bathrobe and ride an escalator into the sunset. Crash and get bundled up in a giant velvet tablecloth and hurled into the valet fountain.
